edits.headline: Iran says it shot down 52nd US MQ-9 drone over Qeshm Island
edits.subheadline: Press TV carried the claim on 16 September, describing the aircraft as the 52nd US MQ-9 drone brought down by Iran.
editorialBody: Iran said it shot down a US MQ-9 drone over Qeshm Island on 16 September, Press TV reported. It said the drone was the 52nd of its type that Iran had downed.

Deutsche Bank said on 16 September it plans to offer bitcoin and ether custody to corporate and institutional clients in Europe, The Block reported. The service will also support the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU and is due to launch this year, subject to regulatory clearance.
OpenAI chief Sam Altman said the world is "right to be afraid" of artificial intelligence but should trust AI firms, BBC News reported.
Citi's Hollenhorst told Bloomberg that the Federal Reserve's rate rise would be "one and done".
Women's hard-won gains are "fragile", according to the Global Gender Gap Report, DW News reported.
